svg.aria-label: 최근 활동 – 공개 저장소 커밋 · 기준 2026-10-31 04:44 KST. 1) meari: release: drop npm distribution; meari ships through cargo/crates.io only (1시간 전). 2) jekyll-theme-modootoday: Release workflow: create the GitHub Release from the CHANGELOG entry after the gem push (2시간 전). 3) jekyll-theme-modootoday: Release 1.1.0: changelog, gem version and install snippets (3시간 전). 4) specfold: C162: refuse U+0085, U+2028, U+2029 in titles (3시간 전). 5) specfold: C161: -C resolves relative path arguments and keeps -C in next (3시간 전). 6) jekyll-theme-modootoday: Optimize: merge duplicate section rule in prose CSS, shorter scroll-region label fallback (3시간 전). 7) jekyll-theme-modootoday: Figures: SVG diagrams in dark mode and horizontal scroll on narrow screens (3시간 전). 8) meari: release: publish only crates missing from crates.io so bootstrap-published versions do not fail the tag run (7시간 전).
